forcedChoices.reason: Men and women ask as a group ('what shall we do'), so the answer uses the plural.
A hostile crowd speaks to one man with no sign of respect.
The prayers speak to God directly; liturgical Spanish uses tú.
The passage speaks to the people as one addressee ('your heart').
